notes.title: 8 years anniversary
notes.content:
Hello little goblins,
Thank you for all your support throughout the years. 8 years, to be more precise, as the first game in the series - Goblin and Coins - was released on November 8th 2016. Time simply flies by. There are two more Goblin and coins games since, a very difficult Goblin and Coins II with metroidvania-lik levels and a focus on exploration and acquiring upgrades, and an easier alternative to it, The Lost Recipes, which is more similar to the first game, with mostly linear levels and unlimited continues. 

In order to celebrate together, a[url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?franchise=Goblin%20and%20Coins] franchise link[/url] has been created on steam, so it's easier to find all the games in the series, and also there will be a significant discount on all three games at the same time a bit later this month (scheduling requirements prevent it from starting today). Don't forget that purchasing a complete-your-collection bundle gives you an additional discount on top of the regular discount. 

Happy 8th goblinversary to all of you! 

PS
There just might be a [url=https://www.steamgifts.com/giveaway/esNdA/]tiny giveaway hidden here[/url].

notes.title: Goblin and Coins II is coming to Steam in April 2023
notes.content:
Goblin and Coins II, a direct sequel to the Goblin and Coins, is planned to release on Steam in April of 2023. The game will feature 25 handcrafted story levels, 5 boss battles, 5 secret/bonus levels and the ability to regain lives/continues when all are lost. The focus is on bringing features gamers requested after enjoying the first game. 

https://youtu.be/u-DVAzLCTy0

Run and jump through a new adventure, explore the world, collect coins, unlock upgrades, revisit levels to find secrets and face enemies old and new. 

[b] What's new? [/b]

[list]
[*] Improved graphics, extended mechanics and simple puzzles 
[*] Create your own difficulty by getting or ignoring the upgrades 
[*] Revisit levels, find secrets, optional easier start for the new players 
[*] No game over - there's a secret way to regain your lost lives... 
[*] It Already supports English, Serbian, Turkish, Brazilian Portuguese and Russian, with more languages coming in the future.  
[/list]

Click here to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/694990/Goblin_and_Coins_II/]follow and wishlist now[/url].

notes.title: Goblin and Coins works on SteamDeck
notes.content:
There's an unofficial confirmation that Goblin and Coins works out of the box on SteamDeck. Here's a picture proof: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26753431/f5c571ee407d435f32fb73bd8f249200da436fcb.png[/img]

We're all waiting for Valve to test and sort all the 60.000+ games on Steam for SteamDeck compatibility. With that amount of material to go through, it's understandable that Goblin and Coins, being a very small indie game, won't be a priority for a while, and that's okay (there's ~1300 games rated so far). 

But while we wait for the official rating, there's many 3rd parties that have access to SteamDeck and with the lifting of embargos and the official release of the handheld, it's now possible to simply have the game tested - not as throuough as Valve's doing it and certainly not with an official verified/playable rating yet - but enough to know there's a 2D platformer you can run on your brand new handheld when that bean soup starts playing it's tune. 

[i]Source for the pic and the test: LiamD from [url=GamingOnLinux.com]GamingOnLinux.com[/url] [/i]. It's an amazing website for all gaming news and reviews related to gaming on GNU/Linux, check it out.

notes.title: Attempt to address the slowdowns
notes.content:
I've pushed a minor change that should in theory address the slowdowns that were happening on windows platform, without the need for players to use dx11 beta build. 

In my tests it works and fps doesn't drop to 24 with everything dragging around slowly, but this was a wild run so you'll have to test for yourself if the game is sticking close to 30fps with gameplay simply flying.

notes.title: Experimental DX11 build available
notes.content:
Ever since Windows 10 v.1703 (Creators Update)  the game (and many other titles) [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/551580/discussions/0/1319962244122649714/]had issues[/url] with the fullscreen mode. At first it was just a black/white screen (easily mitigated with a compatibility mode), which was sort of fixed with the release of Win10FCU (1709) and KB4048955, but for some reason ever since game runs sluggish and under 30 fps even if it worked perfectly fine before... and runs fine on older versions of Windows even today. 

It's playable, and gamers who aren't using frame counters might not even notice, but everything just feels way too slower than intended on random occasions. I've finally decided to try making this experimental DX11 build available, as it should work perfectly fine on any modern computer able to run DirectX 11. The reason I didn't do it earlier is because I wanted to keep backward compatibility with older computers and Windows 7. Using it as a separate build will keep that, while providing normal gameplay and experience to everyone else.

Simply right click the game title in the library, select "properties" and in the Betas tab select "DX11 build" from the dropdown menu. You don't need a password or anything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26753431/e876abeb60673f0325229bb0b6e0b588ecad4478.png[/img]

This game is more than 4 years old and GnC2 is in advanced stage of development, so I can't really promise anything, but I do have some ideas on potentially updating all builds to DX11 and making it default if this proves as a good solution. So if you decide to try it, please let me know if there's any bugs or how it ran compared to the default build for you.

[b]PLEASE NOTE:[/b] Main branch was later [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/551580/view/5471278263756309064]updated as well[/url] so there should be no slowdowns even on DX9. You can still try DX11 branch but it's not necessary.

notes.title: Bored? Draw and maybe win!
notes.content:
Hello little goblins,
We're all stuck at home and it's sometimes hard to keep your mind off what's going on in the world, but if you're willing to try, here's an idea - [b]imagine goblin is stuck at home too[/b]. Because of reasons, I dunno. Hiding from the dragon or something. Now, what would that home look like? What would goblin do to pass the time? Any weird details in that picture? Can you see it in your minds eye? Nice! 

Now get your pens, your pencils, crayons, Wacom tablet, sharpies, watercolors, whatever you prefer, and [b]draw that scene, upload it to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/551580/images/?p=1&browsefilter=mostrecent]game hub[/url] between April 1st and 30th[/b] and tag it [i]#stayhome[/i] in the title. If you feel really really inspired, you can even submit more than one artwork, as long as it's your original work. 

Beauty is in the eye of beholder, and as there's no beholders in this game, I'll just select a few of the most interesting artworks and give them some very small, you could say symbolic, prizes. Yes, it IS steam keys for games. So, this is what we have on offer today:

[list]
[*] 2 copies of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2300/DOOM_II/]DOOM II (1994)[/url]. Might not have the word in the name, but it's eternal alright. 
[*] 1 copy of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/690140/Sword_Legacy_Omen/]Sword Legacy Omen[/url]
[*] 1 copy of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/310950/Street_Fighter_V/]Street Fighter V [/url]
[*] 1 copy of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/585420/Trailmakers/]Trailmakers[/url] 
[*] 2 copies of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/278360/A_Story_About_My_Uncle/]A story about my uncle [/url]
[*]  2 copies of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/783440/Seven_Mysteries_The_Last_Page/]Seven Mysteries: The Last Page[/url]
[/list]

You're not competing for any certain game, but if your artwork is interesting enough I'll reach out and offer you one of the (leftover) games to chose from, then move on to the next person until all the gifts are gone. 

And don't forget,
[list]
[*] Avoid public gatherings
[*] Wash hands thoroughly
[*] Don't touch your face
[*] Air the rooms, disinfect door handles, railings, ...
[*] Avoid close contact with people having symptoms similar to flu
[*] Drink water, eat fruits, exercise, boost immune system...
[*] If possible, work from home
[*] Don't buy all the toilet paper in the store ffs 
[*] If you were in contact with a confirmed patient, call the phone number for your area and ask for instructions
[*] If self-isolating, try to find something to do, wink-wink...
[/list]

notes.title: Toss a goblin to your loved one
notes.content:
I know you long for some more of the goblin's bean-soup my pretties, but the winter is long and full of lost coins and the strains that puts on a friendship can down a dragon if it's not careful, and we know, my pretties, that dragons are not the most careful of beings, all glorious and full of... Well... While you wait for the next chapter in my story, you can warm your heart with friendship and love by sharing the adventure with a loved one. But only if they'll make a bean soup for you later. Or an eggmeal. It's the rule. It is known, goblinisi. 
[i]                                              - Goblin the 1st, master Chef of the royal dungeon cafeteria. [/i]

Besides that, I've temporarily changed discount limit on coupons from 33% to 50%, so if you didn't have luck to craft one randomly, you can subscribe to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/551580/tradingforum/]trading forums[/url] where other Steam users often offer their coupons for trade or even free.

Have fun and don't forget - [i]grab as many coins as you can[/i]!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Spanish and Russian supported now!
notes.content:
Hello goblins,
It's my pleasure to inform you that the game officially supports Russian and Spanish now. If you want to play in a language other than English, simply do this:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753431/1e494860fb664033c1427efcce84a765a802f7a4.png[/img]

Also, there's an additional challenge level for players who already finished the main story (you need to finish the story to unlock access to challenge levels).

[i]Full price too expensive for you? Wishlist the game and be informed whenever it's on sale![/i]
